name: bajzi-plugins
description: Andras Bajza's own Claude Code / Cowork extensions

plugins.name: bajzi
plugins.description: Token-efficient working method: machine setup and drift check from a manifest, per-repo project profiles, methodology selector, autopilot mode, day-run mode skill, night-run overnight story runner, HANDOFF session handover, a status line, context/secret/injection/writer guards, SessionStart hooks and a PreToolUse noisy-output filter.

plugins.name: bajzi-cowork
plugins.description: claude.ai / Cowork-safe subset of bajzi (handoff, autopilot, modszertan skills only; no bin/, hooks or agents). Install this one in claude.ai / Cowork; use bajzi in Claude Code.

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Status line: minutes left until the main thread's prompt cache goes cold

plugins.name: nightrun-pane
plugins.description: /nightrun: pane with the newest night run's sprint states and log tail
